messages:
Priya Rao: Heads up — I'm about to merge the overlay-layer reorg PR (https://git.redwood/infra/overlays/pull/412). It changes how prod inherits secrets (moves from overlays/prod/secrets.yaml -> overlays/base/secret-refs). Will this break any terraform plans during the deploy gate?

Sam Blake: Thanks for the ping. Depends — the TF modules read from ssm path `module.secrets.path` which we set per-overlay in kustomize generator. If prod path moves, tf plan could show diffs. Did you update the tf var mapping in repo infra/terraform/envs/prod.tfvars?

Priya Rao: I updated kustomize only. I didn’t touch prod.tfvars yet. My idea was to unify secret refs in base so both staging and prod use the same kustomize generator.

Arun Patel: Quick check: the CI release gate runs `terraform plan` with the environment tfvars pulled from the overlay. If kustomize-build output changes the secret key names, plan could try to recreate secrets. Best to run a dry run against the terraform state and also `kustomize build overlays/prod` locally.

Marta Chen: Small suggestion: add a featurerollout annotation so we can canary the overlay change to staging first. E.g., ship to staging, wait 24h, then promote to prod. For emergencies, include a rollback overlay that reverts secret refs.

Priya Rao: Good call. I'll hold the PR. Before merging I'll: 1) add prod.tfvars mapping 2) run terraform plan against staging 3) run `kubectl apply --server-dry-run=client -f -` on the kustomize output.

Theo Kim: For the dry-run commands, this is what I run locally:

```
# build kustomize and validate kubernetes objects
kustomize build overlays/prod | kubectl apply --server-dry-run=client -f -

# terraform plan against remote state
terraform init -backend-config="key=state/prod.tfstate"
terraform plan -var-file=infra/terraform/envs/prod.tfvars
```

Arun Patel: Also add a quick tf guard in the release CI: run `grep -q "secret-refs" <(kustomize build overlays/prod)` and fail if not found. That prevents accidental omission. I can add a tiny GH Action step.

Priya Rao: @Arun can you draft that CI step? If it’s small I can include it in this PR.

Arun Patel: Yep — I'll open a follow-up PR in infra/ci: add job `validate-overlay-secrets` that runs before terraform plan. Will include a note to skip with `SKIP_OVERLAY_VALIDATION=1` for emergency.

deploy-bot: deploy approval required: review checks pending — terraform plan, kustomize validation.

Sam Blake: One more thing — secret rotation: if names change we must coordinate with Ops to rotate any external consumers. I added a quick checklist item to the PR description: notify-data-pipelines, update-app-configs.

Marta Chen: If timeline is tight we can ship base change with a compatibility shim: keep old keys around in prod overlay for one roll, then remove after next week. Safer.

Priya Rao: OK locking plan: I'll add prod.tfvars, run staging promotion, wait 24h, then merge. If anything fails we revert base change and push compatibility shim. Thanks all :pray:

Theo Kim: Ping me when you want a hand on the terraform run — happy to pair during the plan step.

Priya Rao: Will do — targeting merge tomorrow after validation.
